payload.summary: Completed, independently reviewed, and integrated wp-operational-coverage, wp-gx10-runtime tasks 8.1-8.4, and the queue-core deployment-identity remediation. Operational coverage now provides durable non-HTTP roots, exhaustive frozen inventory enforcement, bootstrap reconciliation, and truthful backup/restore topology. GX-10 static runtime controls are verified, while task 8.5 and live clean-stack validation remain explicitly incomplete.
completed_work: Integrated queue-core F9 so the worker process-health identity comes from the configured OTEL service name; its exact package suite passed 22/22.
Integrated the independently cleared GX-10 runtime branch; its final exact package evidence passed 327/327 and tasks 8.1-8.4 are coordinator-checked.

Integrated the independently cleared operational package with exhaustive per-file inventory ownership, exactly-once shutdown, durable CLI/MCP/agent/script roots, bootstrap spool reconciliation, and safe backup/restore failure evidence.

Closed the cross-package GX script inventory gap: the runtime proxy-policy reload emits durable pre-PostgreSQL terminal evidence and ten probe/validator/acceptance scripts have exact non-blanket exclusions with specific reasons.

Post-merge verification passed: operational exact 795/795, combined queue/GX focused 74/74, inventory/GX policy 17/17, Bash syntax, Ruff/format, mypy, strict OpenSpec, static GX validator, and whitespace checks.
in_progress: Task 8.5 remains unchecked because the approved clean local stack cold-restart behavior has not run on a capable Docker/Caddy/OpenBao/Squid host; deploy/gx10/VALIDATION.md remains INCOMPLETE.

decisions.title: Keep GX live acceptance separate from verified static runtime controls
decisions.rationale: The package provides executable live harnesses and passes all static/rendered gates, but unavailable host tooling and the unpublished frozen Squid tag prevent an honest cold-restart claim.

decisions.title: Classify GX scripts individually in the frozen operation inventory
decisions.rationale: The runtime proxy reload is a production maintenance entrypoint and receives durable evidence; low-level probes, pure validators, and bounded acceptance fixtures use exact reasoned exclusions rather than a blanket GX path exemption.

next_steps: Implement the now dependency-ready wp-storage-recovery tasks 8.6-8.10 and wp-coexistence tasks 9.1-9.2 in isolated worktrees.
Preserve direct-SQL negative fixtures, generated validator parity, exhaustive inventory enforcement, and the mandatory six-hour GX-10 acceptance gate.
Run task 8.5 only on a capable clean local stack and retain its protected evidence before checking it complete.
